profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: As a software engineer I’ve been able to develop multiple solutions using a broad range of technologies not only related to websites but also related to email marketing. Among the web development technologies I've used vanilla Javascript with ES6, CSS3 with Sass (SCSS), HTML5 to produce engaging and responsive web experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated closely with product managers and cross-functional teams to migrate and re-architect an e-commerce platform.
Enhanced web load time by 36% after migrating to an Elixir application using the Phoenix framework.
Passed the Lighthouse Core Web Vitals Assessment, improving from a previously failing Drupal application.
Oversaw the implementation of native filtering and sorting capabilities, improving speed by 30%.
Collaborated with and supervised 4 engineering teams to ensure timely project delivery and reduction of technical debt.
Planned, prioritized, and scoped feature requests to ensure the highest impact features were delivered first.
Collaborated in the development of a RESTful API to handle 700K product data queries per day.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of 5 developers to create a search micro service to provide a search results page and a search navigation overlay for one of the world’s largest cosmetics companies, encompassing over 25 luxury brands and 200+ websites.
Improved search user experience by adding a custom component for Best sellers and suggested search terms in the landing search results page and landing search navigation overlay.
Utilized a technology stack including React, MobX, Styled Components, TypeScript, Storybook, Jest, and Drupal 7.
Implemented integration with a new search and merchandising vendor to incorporate ranking cocktails.
Mentored a team of 4 developers, providing coaching and guidance. Highlighted areas for improvement and raised concerns when necessary.

positions.title: Javascript Developer
positions.description:
Led the JavaScript team in Buenos Aires, setting development standards for Playtika's global teams.
Followed Scrum as the agile development methodology and utilized the Jira suite for project tracking.
Migrated the legacy admin app for the game to a new admin developed with React for the front end and NodeJS for the back end.
Developed a real-time notification system using Socket.io, NodeJS, and Express.
Utilized technologies including ES6, HTML5, React, GraphQL, Apollo, Kafka, MySQL, and Aerospike.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked for a single client based in United States (ConsumerAffairs)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I participate in requirements gathering, system process documentation, implementation, code reviews, testing and maintenance of ConsumerAffairs platform across different projects and technologies.

We use Scrum as our agile development philosophy, including daily standup meetings, planning, review and retrospectives.

positions.title: Freelance Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed capabilities for a back-office web application focused on common ERP functionalities while working remotely as a freelancer.
Collaborated with developers in Mexico and Venezuela, utilizing AngularJS, SmartAdmin Responsive WebApp, and Bootstrap.
Employed SVN as the revision control system.
Maintained daily communication via Skype and managed development tasks through Asana.

positions.title: Front End Web developer
positions.description:
Web Application Development

Collaborated with a team of developers to create applications using the AngularJS framework and other web technologies, including CSS, Sass, HTML5, Angular Material, PhoneGap, NPM, Gulp, Bower, and Yeoman generator.
Followed the agile software development methodology SCRUM, supported by Taiga as an open-source project management platform.
Utilized the Model-View-Controller architectural pattern for development.
Employed Git as the distributed version control system, adhering to a pull-request git-flow.
Used PivotalTracker to monitor development progress.

Developer Responsibilities

Implemented features such as user registration, profile editing, item listing in views, and session management using LocalStorage and SessionStorage.
Created AngularJS resources to communicate with RESTful endpoints and managed promises using the AngularJS $q service.
Programmed application controllers and developed basic user interfaces or views from mockups.
Utilized JavaScript libraries such as lodash, masonry, moment.js, chart.js, and ng-file-upload.

positions.title: Junior Java Developer
positions.description:
Internship Project

Replaced the deprecated javax.comm communication library with the Rxtx library for serial port communication with GSM modems via AT commands.
Adapted the Java platform for compatibility with Linux environments.

Monitoring and Maintenance  of SMS Platform

Conducted RDBMS analysis and generated reports using MySQL.
Designed and implemented small Java SE modules to enhance platform performance, utilizing multithreading techniques.

Web Development

Developed webpages using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, and the Bootstrap framework.
Modeled and implemented MySQL databases.
Utilized PHP for basic server-side scripting.

courses.name: Curso de Inglés como Lengua Extranjera

projects.title: SIGAP 5
projects.description: Web application design for control, management and tracking of various business requests from inside and outside the company using the app. It's main goal is to improve the handling of requests, avoid delays in resolution through effective tracking of tasks and requests, obtain immediate data, documents and attachments with agile and advanced queries.

projects.title: Taima
projects.description: Aplicación web y móvil en la que se puede expresar opinión sobre diversos temas de interés y ver qué opina la gente sobre éstos, de forma fácil y en tiempo real.
